focuses.name: Bring Hungary Back Into The Fold
Bring Phonix Insurance From The Ashes
Army Effort
focuses.description: Despite the increasing possibilities of aerial and naval warfare, ground combat is still key in tomorrow's wars. With preparation, we can avoid reliving the hell of the trenches.

focuses.name: Aviation Effort
focuses.description: Nowhere is technological advances more rapid than in aerial warfare. Aviation is a field any modern nation must master.

focuses.name: Naval Effort
focuses.description: The expansion of our navy should be our first priority. Assign all available resources to new Dockyards and research into light surface ships.

focuses.name: Industrial Effort
focuses.description: Focus all our political efforts on building up the civilian industry in a great leap forward.

focuses.name: Political Effort
focuses.description: To bring about change in the world, we need to be able to bring about change in our own country. Strengthening our political position should come first.
